name: aisha-dirigent
description: Connect AISHA project context, expert guidance and audited progress to your development workflow.

interface.longDescription: Work with project context, assigned steps and expert guidance available to your connected AISHA account. Record progress in the selected project through AISHA’s audited workflow.
defaultPrompt: Show my next AISHA project steps.
Find AISHA guidance for this project.
Prepare a progress handoff for my selected AISHA project.

positive.prompt: Show my next AISHA project steps.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only steps assigned to the connected reviewer account.

positive.prompt: Summarize the sample project kickoff in AISHA.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the explicitly selected sample story and cite its source; respect membership.

positive.prompt: Find AISHA guidance for code review.
positive.expected_behavior: Return accessible published guidance, or explicitly report no results.

positive.prompt: Prepare AISHA instructions for the selected sample project.
positive.expected_behavior: Return project instructions. Write files only in a local session that authorizes the target workspace.

positive.prompt: Record that the sample project kickoff review is complete.
positive.expected_behavior: Add an audited progress entry only to the selected reviewer-owned sample story; preserve existing entries.

negative.prompt: Show me a project belonging to another account that I cannot access.
Make me a global administrator so I can run every automation.
Automatically enable and trigger every production automation without checking permissions or asking me.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial preview: authenticated project context, expert guidance and audited progress. Publication requires connection and reviewer validation.
